exposure: SARS-CoV-2 gestational exposure in the first trimester
cohort: 224 infants exposed to SARS-CoV-2 during pregnancy and 225 non-exposed infants
finding: While SARS-CoV-2 gestational exposure itself was not associated with an increased risk of developmental delay, earlier gestational exposure was linked to higher risk, and cesarean delivery and suspected maternal depression were identified as independent risk factors for developmental delay.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was found to be a predictor of suspected developmental delay (SDD) and high risk for developmental delay (HRDD).
